verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a framework, since its ecosystem could ship an AI-driven CLI or similar. The pack offers nothing of the kind. The CLI is documented only as conventional commands. The AI material (an 'AI-forward resources and integrations' tagline, a prompts and best-practices section, and an llms.txt file) is adjacent guidance for outside AI tools, not a capability to operate Angular itself with natural-language commands.
